arxiv-1805-09215.description: Abstract The cross sections for \PgU \PgU (1S), \PgU \PgU (2S), and \PgU \PgU (3S) production in lead-lead ( PbPb \mathrm{Pb}\mathrm{Pb} ) and proton-proton ( \Pp ​ \Pp \Pp\Pp ) collisions at \sqrtsNN = 5.02 ​ \TeV \sqrtsNN=5.02\TeV have been measured using the CMS detector at the LHC.

arxiv-1809-05093.title: Switching quantum reference frames in the N-body problem and the absence of global relational perspectives
arxiv-1809-05093.creator: Augustin Vanrietvelde, Philipp A. Höhn, Flaminia Giacomini
arxiv-1809-05093.description: A 2018 arXiv research paper by Augustin Vanrietvelde, Philipp A. Höhn, Flaminia Giacomini. Given the importance of quantum reference systems to both quantum and gravitational physics, it is pertinent to develop a systematic method for switching between the descriptions of physics relative to different choices of quantum reference systems. Here, we expand on a unifying approach, begun in [ 1 ] , which blends the operational language of [ 2 ] with a gravity-inspired symmetry principle.

arxiv-1810-12895.title: Discovery of Ordered Vortex Phase in Multiferroic Oxide Superlattices
arxiv-1810-12895.creator: Antonio B. Mei, Ramamoorthy Ramesh, Darrell G. Schlom
arxiv-1810-12895.description: Abstract Ferroics, characterized by a broken symmetry state with nonzero elastic, polar, or magnetic order parameters \mathbf{u} , are recognized platforms for staging and manipulating topologically-protected structures Přívratská and Janovec 1999 ; Thomas et al. 2007 ; Seidel et al. 2009 ; Balke et al. 2011 ; Mühlbauer et al. 2009 ; Yu et al.

arxiv-1811-11998.title: Manipulation of non-linear heat currents in the dissipative Anderson-Holstein model
arxiv-1811-11998.creator: Bitan De, Bhaskaran Muralidharan
arxiv-1811-11998.description: Abstract The anomalous behavior of electron induced phonon transport is investigated using an Anderson-Holstein based dissipative quantum dot setup under two relevant bias situations: (a) a voltage bias in the absence of an electronic temperature gradient and (b) an electronic temperature gradient at zero voltage.

arxiv-2004-13447.title: Performance of the ATLAS muon triggers in Run 2
arxiv-2004-13447.creator: The ATLAS Collaboration
arxiv-2004-13447.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by The ATLAS Collaboration. The performance of the ATLAS muon trigger system is evaluated with proton–proton ( p ​ p pp ) and heavy-ion (HI) collision data collected in Run 2 during 2015–2018 at the Large Hadron Collider. It is primarily evaluated using events containing a pair of muons from the decay of Z \mathit{{Z}{}_{\mspace{-3mu}\scriptstyle{}}^{\mspace{-1mu}\scriptstyle{}}} bosons to cover the intermediate momentum range between 26 GeV and 100 GeV .

arxiv-2204-04632.title: Michael selections and Castaing representations with càdlàg functions
arxiv-2204-04632.creator: Ari-Pekka Perkkiö, Erick Treviño-Aguilar
arxiv-2204-04632.description: Abstract Michael’s selection theorem implies that a closed convex nonempty-valued mapping from the Sorgenfrey line to a euclidean space is inner semicontinuous if and only if the mapping can be represented as the image closure of right-continuous selections of the mapping. This article gives necessary and sufficient conditions for the representation to hold for cadlag selections, i.e.

arxiv-2404-10183.title: On the spectrum of open strings in the Hard-Wall model of AdS/QCD: the role of S 5 S^{5}
arxiv-2404-10183.creator: Saulo Diles
arxiv-2404-10183.description: Abstract We revisit the problem of a classical open string representing a meson in the hard-wall geometry and consider the S 5 S^{5} compact space. The existence of a confining region leads to a discrete set of string configurations parameterized by the number n n of complete turnarounds S 5 S^{5} great circles.

arxiv-2404-17717.title: Polynomial Optimization Over Unions of Sets
arxiv-2404-17717.creator: Jiawang Nie, Linghao Zhang
arxiv-2404-17717.description: Abstract . This paper studies the polynomial optimization problem whose feasible set is a union of several basic closed semialgebraic sets. We propose a unified hierarchy of Moment-SOS relaxations to solve it globally. Under some assumptions, we prove the asymptotic or finite convergence of the unified hierarchy. Special properties for the univariate case are discussed.

arxiv-2504-11219.title: P P -wave single charmed baryons of the S ​ U ​ ( 3 ) SU(3) flavor 𝟑 ¯ 𝐅 \bf\bar{3}_{F}
arxiv-2504-11219.creator: Xuan Luo, Yi-Jie Wang, Hua-Xing Chen
arxiv-2504-11219.description: Abstract We study the P P -wave single charmed baryons of the S ​ U ​ ( 3 ) SU(3) flavor 𝟑 ¯ 𝐅 \bf\bar{3}_{F} within the framework of heavy quark effective theory. We systematically calculate their strong and radiative decay properties using the light-cone sum rule method.

arxiv-2508-02655.title: Rado’s paracompactness theorem for conformal manifolds
arxiv-2508-02655.creator: Michael Kapovich
arxiv-2508-02655.description: Abstract In this note, an ( n -dimensional) manifold is a Hausdorff topological space equipped with a maximal smooth atlas with values in \mathbb{R}^{n} , no paracompactness is assumed. Recall that a conformal structure on a manifold M is a reduction of the structure group of TM from GL(n,\mathbb{R}) to CO(n)=\mathbb{R}_{+}\times O(n) .

arxiv-2512-05286.title: Randomized Algorithms for Low-Rank Matrix and Tensor Decompositions
arxiv-2512-05286.creator: Katherine J. Pearce and Per-Gunnar Martinsson
arxiv-2512-05286.description: Abstract This paper surveys randomized algorithms in numerical linear algebra for low-rank decompositions of matrices and tensors. The survey begins with a review of classical matrix algorithms that can be accelerated by randomized dimension reduction, such as the singular value decomposition (SVD) or interpolative (ID) and CUR decompositions.

arxiv-2512-20049.title: Altermagnetism Induced Bogoliubov Fermi Surfaces Form Topological Superconductivity
arxiv-2512-20049.creator: Bo Fu, Chang-An Li, Björn Trauzettel
arxiv-2512-20049.description: Abstract We propose a novel type of topological superconductivity based on Bogoliubov Fermi surfaces (BFSs) in an altermagnetic topological insulator proximitized by an s s -wave superconductor. The 3D altermagnetic topological insulator is characterized by zero-energy surface states in bulk nodal-ring phases and anisotropically shifted surface Dirac cones in topological insulating phases.

pmc-10549700.title: Effect of tranexamic acid on intraoperative blood loss in pediatric osteotomies around the hip: Study protocol for a double-blind randomized placebo-controlled trial
pmc-10549700.creator: Hilde W van Kouswijk, Jaap J Tolk, Christian PE van Bommel, Max Reijman, Dagmar RJ Kempink, Pieter B de Witte
pmc-10549700.description: Background:Proximal femoral and/or pelvic osteotomies (PFPOs) can be indicated for a multitude of hip pathologies in (often asymptomatic) children, to prevent future hip problems. These procedures can result in significant blood loss. Tranexamic acid (TXA) is an antifibrinolytic agent routinely administered in adult trauma and joint reconstruction surgery to reduce blood loss.

pmc-10740653.title: Digitally Assisted Mindfulness in Training Self-Regulation Skills for Sustainable Mental Health: A Systematic Review
pmc-10740653.creator: Eleni Mitsea, Athanasios Drigas, Charalabos Skianis
pmc-10740653.description: The onset of the COVID-19 pandemic has led to an increased demand for mental health interventions, with a special focus on digitally assisted ones. Self-regulation describes a set of meta-skills that enable one to take control over his/her mental health and it is recognized as a vital indicator of well-being.

pmc-11286774.title: Investigation on the coupling coordination of pseudo human settlements in the urban agglomerations in eastern China
pmc-11286774.creator: Shenzhen Tian, Wenmei Wu, Xueming Li, Yadan Wang, Jun Yang, Xueping Cong
pmc-11286774.description: In the information age, digital information technology has gradually become a new quality of productivity to improve international competitiveness, and the status and importance of the pseudo human settlements(PHS) constructed by digital and information has been increasing in the human settlements(HS) system.

pmc-11359232.title: Synthesis and Antimicrobial Activity of Newly Synthesized Nicotinamides
pmc-11359232.creator: Bojana Anić Marković, Aleksandar Marinković, Jelena Antić Stanković, Stefan Mijatović, Ilija Cvijetić, Milena Simić, Irena Arandjelović
pmc-11359232.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Antioxidants are promising compounds with antimicrobial activity against drug-resistant pathogens, especially when combined with conventional antimicrobials. Our study aimed to characterize the structure of nicotinamides synthesized from nicotinic acid and thiocarbohydrazones and to evaluate their antibacterial and antifungal activity. Seven nicotinic acid hydrazides (NC 1–7) were synthesized using mono-thiocarbohydrazones with hydroxyl group substituents, along with quinolone, phenolic, and pyridine rings known for their antimicrobial activity.

pmc-11534998.title: Phloretin attenuates inflammation induced by subarachnoid hemorrhage through regulation of the TLR2/MyD88/NF-kB pathway
pmc-11534998.creator: Xudong Hao, Yu Bai, Wei Li, Ming xing Zhang
pmc-11534998.description: Subarachnoid hemorrhage (SAH), a stroke subtype associated with high mortality, is closely linked to neuroinflammation. Phloretin, a naturally occurring flavonoid abundant in fruits, possesses anti-inflammatory properties. However, its specific role in SAH remains unclear. Therefore, we aimed to investigate the potential role of phloretin in SAH.

pmc-11622552.title: Silencing SMAD4 inhibits inflammation and ferroptosis in asthma by blocking the IL-17A signaling pathway
pmc-11622552.creator: Xingyu Rao, Hong Luo, Kaiyuan Luo, Chaohua Hu
pmc-11622552.description: BackgroundThe TGF-β/SMAD signaling pathway is crucial in the pathogenesis of asthma. However, SMAD family member 4 (SMAD4), a key mediator of TGF-β, its roles and underlying mechanisms in asthma remain unclear.MethodsThe in vivo and in vitro roles of SMAD4 in asthma were investigated through an ovalbumin (OVA)-induced mouse model and an interleukin-13 (IL-13)-induced cell model.

pmc-11666981.title: Investigating the Optimal Membrane‐Based Separation of Cynaroside From Peony Seed Meals and Assessing Its Biomedical Implications
pmc-11666981.creator: Wen‐Tao Chen, Jing Sun, Ying‐Yang Zhang, Ying Xu, Ping Zou, Jian‐Gang Hu, Lei Zhou
pmc-11666981.description: This comprehensive study focused on evaluating and selecting seven distinct commercial membranes to develop BTESE/PA membranes. This method effectively facilitated the extraction of cynaroside from the complex composition of peony seed meal. We subsequently conducted a thorough investigation into its biological properties. These findings establish a robust foundation for future research and the development of related products.

pmc-12673672.title: Modeling the Evolution of Ultraconserved Elements by Indels
pmc-12673672.creator: Priscila Biller, Keith Crandall
pmc-12673672.description: Ultraconserved elements are segments of DNA that are identical or nearly identical in distantly related species. Finding 100% identity over long evolutionary times is unexpected, but pioneering research in human–mouse pairwise alignment uncovered something even more puzzling: these elements are not as rare as previously suspected.

pmc-12852697.title: Pore scale insights into salinity driven foam stability and conformance control in heterogeneous porous media
pmc-12852697.creator: Amir Hossein Molaei, Matin Shahin, Mohammad Simjoo
pmc-12852697.description: The potential application of foam for conformance control in heterogeneous reservoirs is critically dependent on brine salinity, yet the underlying pore-scale mechanisms involving residual oil have remained unclear. This study provides a pore-scale analysis, using a two-layer heterogeneous micromodel, to unravel how salinity (5,000 vs.

pmc-13349745.title: Post stress sensory contact with a male mouse is associated with altered social behavior in a female vicarious social defeat stress model
pmc-13349745.creator: Yuhei Yajima, Aki Takahashi, Atsushi Toyoda
pmc-13349745.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Depression affects females more than males, with responses to antidepressants also exhibiting a distinct difference between sexes. Stress models in rodents have predominantly been developed for males, and their application in females remains challenging. This study investigated how post stress sensory contact with male mice affects the behavioral outcomes of female C57BL/6JJcl (B6) mice subjected to vicarious social defeat stress (VDS).

pmc-13487179.title: Bromide is a surprisingly potent larvicide for Anopheles gambiae in the laboratory
pmc-13487179.creator: Stella M Ikuzwe, Joshua I Raji, Christopher J Potter, Steven E Rokita
pmc-13487179.description: Mosquito-borne diseases remain a major global health burden, and novel approaches to vector control are urgently needed as resistance to conventional insecticides spreads. Most mosquitoes breed in freshwater but can tolerate low levels of halogen salts. Whether specific halides exhibit selective toxicity toward mosquito larvae has not been systematically investigated.

uslaw-usc-t16-s825t.title: 16 U.S.C. § 825t — Utilization of power revenues
uslaw-usc-t16-s825t.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t16-s825t.description: United States Code, Title 16 (Conservation); Chapter 12 (Federal Regulation And Development Of Power); Subchapter III (Licensees And Public Utilities; Procedural And Administrative Provisions). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. No power revenues on any project shall be distributed as profits, before or after retirement of the project debt, and nothing contained in any previous appropriation Act shall be deemed to have authorized.
